source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new test_utf16_response task calls equal with only actual and expected values for HTTP status, XML id and XML text. Add a nonempty message that states each expected behavior, such as status should be 200, parsed id should be utf16, and text should preserve the Japanese characters. Its adjacent stringContains message does not supply messages for those separate assertions. This is the deliberate assertion-message requirement applied to these changed sites, not a new learned rule or an executed test failure.
title: The CalDAV UTF-16 response task leaves three assertions unnamed
